questions.question: How does Zephaniah 3 end after pronouncing judgment?
options: With a final word of complete destruction
With a vision of locusts devouring the land
With a song of joy and God's delight in his people
With a list of the nations still to be judged
questions.answer: With a song of joy and God's delight in his people

questions.question: What does Zephaniah 3 say the LORD will do in the midst of his people?
options: Rejoice over them with gladness and exult over them with loud singing
Turn himself away from them and hide his face in his fierce anger
Scatter them all abroad like chaff among the far and the distant nations
Repay them all in full according to every one of their wicked deeds
questions.answer: Rejoice over them with gladness and exult over them with loud singing

questions.question: Zephaniah 3 says the LORD your God is in your midst, a mighty one who will save.
